title: Scientists Have Discovered Where Native Hawaiians Came From, And The Genetic Effect of Their Long Voyage
caption:
New research reveals the deep genetic connection between Native Hawaiians and the people of Rapa Nui. By tracing ancestral migrations, scientists have identified unique health markers that could change the future of genetic screening.

Source: Sciencealert - Scientists Have Discovered Where Native Hawaiians Came From, And The Genetic Effect of Their Long Voyage
